_grammar: rules/class_abilities.py, module docstring. The engine reads these fields and never these names.
_performance_note: Every performance shares the toggle key `bardic performance` with `exclusive: true`: the book allows one at a time, and starting another ends the one playing. Each costs a round of the bardic performance pool to start and a round each round it holds. Starting is a standard action, a move action from 7th, a swift action from 13th. What it lays on others is linked to the bard's own stance and evaporates with it.

abilities.name: Inspire Courage
abilities.source: CRB p.36 Inspire Courage: allies who can hear the bard gain +1 competence on attack and weapon damage rolls (and +1 morale on saves against charm and fear), +2 at 5th, +3 at 11th, +4 at 17th.
abilities.text: Allies: +1 competence on attack and weapon damage (+2 at 5th, +3 at 11th, +4 at 17th).
not_yet: The morale bonus on saves against charm and fear: saves carry no charm or fear descriptor yet.
Hearing: everyone on the bard's side in the scene is inspired; distance and deafness are not read.

abilities.name: Inspire Competence
abilities.source: CRB p.37 Inspire Competence: one ally within 30 ft gains +2 competence on one skill, +1 for every four levels after 3rd (+3 at 7th, +4 at 11th, +5 at 15th, +6 at 19th). The bard cannot inspire competence in herself.
abilities.text: One ally: +2 competence on one skill (name it in brackets).
abilities.tell: {name} coaches an ally through the work.

abilities.name: Fascinate
abilities.source: CRB p.36 Fascinate: one creature within 90 ft, +1 for every three levels beyond 1st; Will save DC 10 + 1/2 bard level + Cha negates; fascinated while the bard performs.
abilities.text: Will save or fascinated while you play — one creature, more as you rise.
not_yet: A threat breaking the fascination early: the condition holds until the performance ends.

abilities.name: Dirge of Doom
abilities.source: CRB p.37 Dirge of Doom: enemies within 30 ft are shaken while they hear the performance (mind-affecting, no save).
abilities.text: Enemies within 30 ft are shaken while you play.

abilities.name: Inspire Greatness
abilities.source: CRB p.37 Inspire Greatness: one willing ally within 30 ft, +1 for every three levels beyond 9th: 2 bonus Hit Dice (d10) as temporary hit points with Con applied, +2 competence on attack rolls, +1 competence on Fortitude saves.
abilities.text: One ally (more as you rise): 2d10 temporary hp, +2 attack, +1 Fortitude.
not_yet: The two bonus Hit Dice counting as Hit Dice for effects like sleep.

abilities.name: Inspire Heroics
abilities.source: CRB p.37 Inspire Heroics: one ally within 30 ft, +1 for every three levels beyond 15th: +4 morale on saving throws and +4 dodge AC.
abilities.text: One ally (more as you rise): +4 morale on saves, +4 dodge AC.

_not_yet: Countersong and distraction (a Perform check standing in for saves against sonic and illusion effects): saves carry no sonic or pattern descriptor.
Suggestion, mass suggestion, soothing performance, frightening tune and deadly performance: each works as a spell the cast door would have to run on the bard's behalf.
Versatile performance: a Perform bonus standing in for two skills is a skill reader on the sheet, and the Perform type is a class choice lane 1 has not stored yet.
